Name: Mine On Day 1 (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

[b]What is enabled on day 1?[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Mining Cave is accessible on Day 1[/*]
[*]Community Center Event can be trigged on day 1 (Bus Area into Pelican Town trigger event)[/*]
[*]Marnie reaches out on day 1 to adopt pet.[/*]
[*]Willy returns early from his fishing trip on day 1 triggers mail that triggers the meet willy event to get your fishing rod. Willy is also in shop on day 1 to sell his usual fishing product but does not run his normal route until day 2.[/*]
[/list][b]Config Options[/b] - Each of these features can be turned off but requires hard reset of game afterwards.

[b]Requirements[/b] SMAPI, optional Generic Mod Config Menu

[b]Consider endorsing[/b] if mod is useful or added to your game play.

[url=https://github.com/jessevang/MineOnDay1]Source Code[/url]

Downloads.Description: Fix Community Event to allow it trigger even after day 1 up to day 5.
